commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: accurate 3D modelling reference for STU-Town community farm. Input image 1 is the APPROVED MASTER STYLE AND SHAPE reference, not an edit target. Match that reference object's silhouette, proportions, details, warm honey oak wood grain, bevels, brass/teal accents where present, believable materials and charming polished cozy stylized 3D rendering as closely as possible. Not a redesign. Do not add unrelated game systems. Output ONE high-resolution landscape 3:2 technical turntable reference sheet, clean 3 columns x 2 rows equally sized panels with subtle gutters on a plain warm pale gray studio background. Top row: FRONT, BACK, LEFT. Bottom row: RIGHT, TOP, BOTTOM. These are SIX VIEWS OF THE SAME EXACT OBJECT, consistent geometry/materials, consistent physical scale, orthographic cameras, diffuse neutral studio lighting, no depth of field. Frame the whole object in every cell with adequate margins, no cropping. Front is object facing toward viewer; all details stay attached to the same physical locations as the camera changes. TOP and BOTTOM must be genuine overhead and underside views, not six repeated 3/4 views. No writing, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no watermark, no UI in the generated sheet: Vietnamese view captions will be added as editable text outside the image. Any sign or nameplate on the model must be blank. Keep every cell uncluttered and the object large and clear.

sheets.name: Toàn cảnh nông trại
sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high-resolution 3:2 landscape environment reconstruction reference sheet of the EXACT community farm shown in input image 1. Input is the approved master layout and style reference. SIX PANELS, a clean 3 by 2 grid. Top row: FRONT elevated south view like source, BACK elevated north view, LEFT elevated west view. Bottom row: RIGHT elevated east view, TOP pure orthographic plan, FRONT-RIGHT elevated 3/4 overall. No text, captions, labels, numbers, HUD, controls, people, mouse or game interface. Blank wooden signs only. These six views depict ONE SINGLE FIXED MAP GEOMETRY with identical placements and landscaping, not six alternative designs. Warm honey oak raised beds, cream stone paths, cozy stylized 3D quality, natural detailed foliage and soft warm daylight like source. Whole 16m wide by 12m deep rectangular farm diorama visible in every panel; neutral pale gray outside the diorama. North is the rear tool shed side, south is the entrance side. Fixed world plan: EXACTLY FOUR raised beds in 2 by 2 grid, broad open cross-shaped cream stone walking paths. Southwest bed EMPTY tilled dark soil; northwest bed tomato plants with red fruit; northeast bed golden ripe corn; southeast bed leafy strawberry plants with red berries and white flowers. Shed with warm horizontal timber siding, teal roof, ivy, open side shelves and hanging tools stands in NORTHWEST boundary corner behind tomato bed; round oak water barrel on stone stand with metal hoops, brass spigot and silver watering can stands at NORTHEAST boundary corner behind corn. Cyan upright spiral exit portal with teal/gold plinth stands in SOUTHWEST entrance corner, outside empty bed with clear walking access. Warm oak low fencing encloses edges with clear opening at SOUTH center entrance, planted flowers and low hedges at boundary, two mature round green trees on west/east perimeter outside paths. Keep trees from obscuring beds in elevation. Six cameras change only viewpoint: never swap beds, mirror shed/barrel, add/delete portals or change fence style. All details match the original approved reference as closely as possible. No floating UI panels or words anywhere.
